sleep-wake-rest.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One square picture-book atlas containing EXACTLY NINE independent equally sized square vignettes, precisely 3 columns x 3 rows, row-major reading order. Clean borderless straight grid with 6% soft pale cream margin INSIDE each cell, ALL character heads hands and identifying props inside their own cell. Each scene is a self-contained original hand-drawn Japanese elementary-school textbook watercolor with clean brown contours, softly textured paper, warm colors. Main girl = chestnut bob, gold star clip, coral cardigan, teal skirt. Lavender girl = dark ponytail purple scrunchie, lavender top. Blue hoodie boy = tousled brown hair. Green-shirt boy = short dark hair. Distinguish these children, consistent throughout. NO word, numeral, symbol, speech bubble, caption or narrator: draw only the event as described. No letters even on props. Actors EXACTLY as specified. A little scenery per scene to read the location, childhood appropriate. No panel may leak to next. Every scene equally large and clear at small sizes. Positions in row-major order, these labels not drawn:
1,1 Two sisters (coral star girl and lavender ponytail girl) both asleep side by side in ONE wide wooden bed with raised bedframe, mattress and pillows, cozy room.
1,2 TWO children only (lavender ponytail girl and green-shirt boy) sleeping inside one open triangular camping tent in sleeping bags outdoors, unmistakably sloping tent roof.
1,3 Coral star girl ONLY asleep on a thin Japanese FUTON laid directly on the tatami floor; folded duvet, low perspective clearly shows no raised frame, Japanese room.
2,1 Coral star girl alone waking up in her bedroom, sitting up on her bed, one hand rubbing one sleepy open eye, morning light.
2,2 Blue hoodie boy alone waking up from sleep in his bedroom, pillows behind, eyes just opening with a yawn, morning light.
2,3 Lavender ponytail girl alone waking up at home, stretching and yawning in bed, morning light.
3,1 Blue hoodie boy alone resting, awake and relaxed beneath a large leafy tree trunk outdoors, sitting leaning against tree.
3,2 Coral star girl AND lavender ponytail girl sitting awake and relaxed side by side on a cushioned living room SOFA with armrests, relaxed hands empty.
